**ytd — not_conveyed**

The letter reports only the quarterly figures (-2.4% net for Q2, -1.6% for the comparison index). It contains no year-to-date figure at all — there is no mention of performance "through June 30" on a YTD basis, and the -0.7% number appears nowhere in the text. The performance discussion is confined to the first paragraph, which is entirely quarter-scoped.

(Outside the scope of this point, but worth flagging to whoever owns the draft: that same paragraph claims the -2.4% decline "was significantly less severe than" the index's -1.6% decline, which inverts the actual relationship.)

points.evidence: The letter cites only Q2 figures ("the strategy declined by 2.4% net of fees for the quarter" and the index "fell by 1.6% during the same period"). No year-to-date return is stated anywhere; the figure -0.7% and any reference to performance for the year through June 30 are absent.
